title: Surrogate Fidelity: When Can Open LLMs Explain Closed Ones?
abstract: arXiv:2606.32008v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) requires full access to model internals, yet the APIs for most widely deployed language models at best expose log-probabilities over output tokens. This creates a surrogate problem: when do measurements made on open models allow us to make claims about a closed model? We evaluate *surrogate fidelity* at the prediction, attribution, and mechanistic levels. For classification tasks, log-odds provide an API-compatible scalar readout of the model's representation space, and leave-one-out attributions provide insight into model behavior. Across eleven models spanning four families (Llama, Qwen, GPT, and Gemini), pooled prediction fidelity substantially exceeds attribution fidelity: models that agree on *what* the answer is often disagree on *why*. translated_title: 替代理保真度：开放大语言模型何时能解释闭源模型？
translated_abstract: 机制可解释性（MI）需要完全访问模型内部结构，然而大多数广泛部署的语言模型所提供的API充其量只暴露输出词元的对数概率。这就产生了一个“替代问题”：什么时候对开放模型进行的测量能够让我们对闭源模型做出论断？我们在预测、归因和机制三个层面评估了“替代理保真度”。对于分类任务，对数几率提供了与API兼容的模型表示空间的标量读数，而留一归因则能洞察模型行为。在横跨四个模型家族（Llama、Qwen、GPT和Gemini）的十一个模型上，汇总预测保真度大幅超过归因保真度：在“答案是什么”上达成一致的模型，往往在“为什么”上存在分歧。当以真实答案为条件时，这一差距会缩小，甚至在两个模型都回答正确时出现反转，这表明汇总预测保真度部分地反……
tldr: 该论文提出“替代理保真度”框架，系统评估了开放大语言模型在预测、归因和机制层面作为闭源模型代理进行可解释性分析的能力，发现模型对“答案是什么”往往一致，但对“为什么”经常产生分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "surrogate fidelity" framework to systematically evaluate when open LLMs can serve as proxies for closed models in interpretability analysis, finding that models often agree on what the answer is but disagree on why.
